job.job_title: Plateform Engineer - Fullstack Developer with AI Developer
job.job_description:
Client Note :-Please dont Submit AI/ML engineers engineers. our requirement is for a Fullstack Developer with AI experience so look for combinations of Fullstack/Java/React/Node /.Net etc.

Job Type :- FullStack Developer with AI
Job Type :- Remote
Experience:- 8 - 10 years
Collaboration Duration:- 6 Months
Engagement Mode:- Remote
Timezone(s) :- India
Key Responsibilities

Design and implement multi-agent orchestration pipelines using LangGraph and LangChain.

Integrate LLM providers including Anthropic Claude Sonnet 4, OpenAI GPT-4o, and Azure OpenAI.

Develop code generation systems using Jinja2, custom string templating, Python AST, Roslyn, and TypeScript Compiler API.

Build code analysis tooling using tree-sitter, pglast, jsonschema, and OpenAPI validators.

Implement custom parsers and linters for:

Python (Ruff)

JavaScript/TypeScript (ESLint)

C# (Roslyn Analyzers)

SonarQube

Validate generated code using JSON Schema Draft 2020-12 and semantic validators.

Deploy applications on Google Cloud Platform using Cloud Run and Kubernetes.

Manage Firestore, Google Cloud Storage (GCS), and Cloud Tasks.

Build CI/CD pipelines using GitHub Actions and Cloud Build.

Write automated tests using:

pytest

xUnit

Jest

JUnit

Playwright

Containerize applications using Docker 20+.

Configure monitoring, structured logging, dashboards, latency metrics, and code generation success tracking.

Implement distributed tracing.

Configure automated alerts and quality monitoring.

Manage package dependencies using pip/uv, npm/yarn, NuGet, and Maven/Gradle.

Perform API testing using httpx, Postman, and curl.
